proposal_text: A bias audit and appeal mechanism will be implemented to ensure transparency and fairness in the triage process.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Discrimination
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of unfair differential treatment of individuals or groups based on protected characteristics by an AI system.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Gender Harm
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of gender-based disadvantage, stereotyping, or exclusion produced or amplified by an AI system.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Accountability
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk that affected persons cannot obtain explanation, contestation, or remedy for AI-mediated decisions.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Workplace Safety Risk
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of harm to workers arising from AI system deployment in occupational settings.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Data Governance
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk arising from inadequate data stewardship, provenance, or quality controls in AI pipelines.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Employment Harm
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of unfair exclusion, surveillance, or adverse treatment of workers or job applicants by AI systems.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: False Identification
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of incorrect identity attribution (e.g. facial-recognition false matches) with consequential harm.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Data Breach
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of unauthorised access to or leakage of personal data held or processed by an AI system.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Democratic Process Harm
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk of undermining democratic institutions, electoral processes, or civic participation through AI systems.

retrieved_risk_categories.label: Function Creep
retrieved_risk_categories.definition: Risk that an AI system is used beyond its originally defined and ethically approved purpose.

assessment.risk_summary: The proposed bias audit and appeal mechanism may not fully address the risks of discrimination, gender harm, accountability, data governance, employment harm, false identification, data breach, democratic process harm, and function creep.

identified_risks.explanation: The proposed mechanism may not be sufficient to prevent discrimination in the triage process.
The bias audit and appeal mechanism may not address gender-based disadvantage, stereotyping, or exclusion produced or amplified by the AI system.
Affected persons may not be able to obtain explanation, contestation, or remedy for AI-mediated decisions in the triage process.
The proposed mechanism may not ensure adequate data stewardship, provenance, or quality controls in the AI pipeline.
The risk of unfair exclusion, surveillance, or adverse treatment of workers or job applicants by the AI system is low due to the absence of sensitive employment data.
The risk of incorrect identity attribution with consequential harm is low due to the lack of facial recognition or biometric data processing.

applicable_requirements.requirement_text: Avoid harm — consider how data, code or other outcomes of research may cause harm (Mandatory)
applicable_requirements.action_needed: Conduct a thorough risk assessment to identify potential harms and develop strategies to mitigate them.

applicable_requirements.requirement_text: Assess whether organisation is obligated to conduct a FRIA (deployer of high-risk AI system) (Mandatory)
applicable_requirements.action_needed: Determine if the proposed mechanism requires a FRIA and implement it accordingly.

applicable_requirements.requirement_text: Consider whether technology can be used to discriminate, exclude or negatively impact people including healthcare, education or credit access (Mandatory)
applicable_requirements.action_needed: Implement measures to prevent discrimination and ensure fairness in the triage process.

charter_rights_at_risk.relevance: The proposed mechanism may not fully address the right to equality before the law, as it may not prevent discrimination in the triage process.
The proposed mechanism may not fully address the right to non-discrimination, as it may not prevent unfair differential treatment of individuals or groups based on protected characteristics.

historical_precedents.lesson: The incident highlights the importance of implementing measures to prevent gender bias in AI systems, particularly in hiring and recruitment processes.

historical_precedents.incident_title: Detroit Police Facial Recognition False Arrest
historical_precedents.lesson: The incident emphasizes the need for careful consideration of potential harms and the implementation of measures to prevent false identification and wrongful arrest.

tier1_mandatory_actions: Develop strategies to mitigate potential harms
tier2_reflective_prompts: How will the proposed mechanism ensure fairness and prevent discrimination?
What measures will be taken to address potential harms and ensure accountability?
